pull_requests.title: Exhibit identical-resultant three-term cyclic slices of ranks 14 and 15
pull_requests.body:
## Exact result
For the literal 15x15 cyclic-source coefficient matrix at a=b=3 and f=x²+z(1+x²)+z²(1+t x+c x²), an exact polynomial identity gives
`det R = t(2c³-2ct²+t⁴)`.
The two specializations (c,t)=(2,0) and (1,1) each have coefficient degrees (2,2,2), primitive degree 2, and all three pairwise resultants equal to 1, yet ranks 14 and 15 over every field of characteristic not 2. The first has an explicit integral left kernel and a -4 minor; the second has unit determinant.

This disproves classification of the rank by those coarse invariants. It **does not** prove a source-space cap, tensor degeneration, or exponent below 9/4.

## Evidence
- Written proof and complete matrix convention: research/ai/2026-10-23-three-term-resultant-obstruction/proof.md
- Dependency-free 256-point integer polynomial identity certificate, exact minor, and modular rank controls: verify.py, saved report under results/three-term-resultant-obstruction-2026-10-23/
- Focused test locally passed: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_three_term_resultant_obstruction.py' -v`.
- `python -I research/ai/2026-10-23-three-term-resultant-obstruction/verify.py` passed.
- Whole-repository regression, historical archive replay, and hosted required CI are not yet verified on this branch. Do not merge until they pass.

## Provenance and next question
Claim `AI-THREE-TERM-RESULTANT-OBSTRUCTION-001`, status **proof-written-unreviewed**. Literal source convention pinned to blob `04d28c6a05027a7756891f47d28327de850a7501`; prior affine recurrence remains credited to PR #209 (head `4247f42`, superseded by consolidation PR #214). PR #207 owns diagonal Toeplitz problems. This investigation concerns non-diagonal coefficient triples.

Next: compute the two polynomial-kernel minimal indices of `u λ_r+v λ_(r+1)+w λ_(r+2)=0` and determine sufficient higher subresultant/syzygy invariants. Avoid another search using only pairwise resultants.

Consolidation PR #214 is concurrently integrating prior branches and may require a documentation/ledger rebase before this PR can merge.

pull_requests.title: Reduce a full-source two-sided A4 construction to a 46-dimensional compression problem
pull_requests.body:
## Result and reason for this investigation

The full A4 target M(10,10,11) requires singular long maps. This PR studies all 112 normalized source slices under two-sided conjugation by `I+t^-1*N`, followed by arbitrary constant rank-110 input/output compressions and an arbitrary Laurent first map. N is the credited square-zero source slice of rank 16.

The exact saturated limiting space L has dimension 112 and acts by scalars on a fixed 12-dimensional subspace. If compression loses ell leading directions, its full re-saturated limit can recover at most ell additional directions. A full target requires at least nine lost directions:
`dim(P L C) <= 103`.

The proof includes the directions that return after a leading coefficient is killed; it does not identify a projected leading space with the true compressed limit.

## Complete finite coordinate result

All 6,216 principal two-coordinate deletions have projected dimension at least 108, certified by ranks modulo 1009. The rank histogram is 108:3, 109:4, 110:221, 111:211, 112:5777. These modular ranks are lower bounds on complex dimension, so all principal compressions in this family fail the necessary loss-of-nine condition.

## Reduction of arbitrary constant compressions

The structural follow-up gives the complete lower-block form of L. Using the credited minimum-rank-six theorem and a proved transpose-conjugation identity, every element of L with ordinary rank at most four must be supported entirely in its bottom-left 28-by-28 block.

That block is the explicit 46-dimensional space
`E = G + [G,F] + F G F`,
where G is the 16-dimensional outer source space and F=G00.

Every matrix killed by two codimension-two compressions has rank at most four. Consequently a successful arbitrary constant compression requires rank-26 maps Phat (26 by 28) and Chat (28 by 26) with
`dim(Phat E Chat) <= 37`.

Equivalently, there must be a 26-dimensional U and a two-dimensional W for which `{X in E : X(U) subset W}` has dimension at least nine. A universal image-dimension bound of 38 would exclude every constant compression of this fixed family. That bound remains unproved; satisfying the necessary condition would still not supply the full target tensor identity.

Claims `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-COORDINATE-002` and `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003` remain written and unreviewed.

## Completed exploratory continuations

Two additional specified two-sided paths were checked on every principal pair:

| Path | Principal pairs | Exact re-saturations required | Survivors |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Two noncommuting square-zero factors | 6,216 | 0 | 0 |
| Moving unit from their nonnilpotent sum | 6,216 | 221 | 0 |

All 221 re-saturations were accepted by exact rational polynomial identities. Each limit has an explicit invariant coordinate subspace with dimension not divisible by ten, excluding the full target. Invariance is checked over Q, not inferred from modular zeroes.

The note also proves the whole-subspace refinement `ell >= 10*ceil((s-2)/11)-1`. It raises the required loss to 29 for the two-factor path with a 29-dimensional scalar-action subspace. These computations add no target construction or separate theorem claim.

## Verification and receipts

The standard-library source verifier reconstructs the literal tensor and exact normalization, replays complete polynomial coefficients, and checks all 112 leading matrices and all coordinate pairs. The block verifier checks 112 full coordinate identities, all 16 transpose identities, and the dimension 46.

- Frozen substantive tree `363271b34a2b82dd033b388d7b48d00f1e76d1f9`: all 905 unique test IDs have passing evidence, from a 288-test prefix and three disjoint remaining shards.
- The initial union had one broken-link failure in an untracked scratch draft. The failed shard, two unsuccessful scratch retries, and the final successful correction are retained. No tracked code or test was changed to bypass the check.
- All five historical archive replays passed.
- The structural follow-up passed three new tests, all 18 repository checks, and the updated source-pin check. Fresh block discovery reproduced the certificate byte-identically.
- The final exploratory script reproduced both complete reports byte-identically and passed the 18 metadata/link/archive-manifest checks.
- Follow-up receipts pin their exact files; they do not claim a fresh full-suite run at every later documentation checkpoint.

Current published tree: `f0d4a8742b85c5ad760b30c6633bbcdd29f71247`, identical to local checkpoint `5bce59f`.

The PR is ready for review. Hosted CI remains pending and must pass before merging.

## Scope and attribution

The original tensor, normalization, source slice, and minimum-rank theorem retain their existing attribution and exact source pins. The new contributions are the full two-sided limit, rank-loss requirement, coordinate exclusion, and 46-dimensional necessary reduction.

Arbitrary noncoordinate compressions in the remaining locus, moving compressions, and other singular source paths remain open. No full target, improved exponent, historical priority, independent mathematical review, or formalization is claimed.

Owner-directed OpenAI Codex work. Root and sibling-agent proof readings are checks within one generating session. Related work: #211 and #212.
